name: B360 Cache & Optimize
author: brijesh7191

sections.description:
B360 Cache & Optimize helps manage WordPress performance features from a single admin screen, including static page cache, CSS and JavaScript optimization, lazy loading, database cleanup, cache exclusions, and CDN settings.

B360 Cache & Optimize is the free WordPress.org plugin. All features included in this package work without a product key, trial, quota, or paid account.

Third Party Services

Privacy Policy: https://b360cacheoptimize.online/privacy-policy/

This plugin does not send product-key requests or require a remote account for the features included in the WordPress.org package.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the b360-cache-optimize folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate B360 Cache & Optimize from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the B360 Cache & Optimize admin menu to configure optimization settings.
sections.faq:
Does B360 Cache & Optimize require a paid account?

No. The optimization controls included in this WordPress.org build work without a paid account or product key.

Does B360 Cache & Optimize connect to an external service?

No external service is required for the features included in this WordPress.org package.
